When I first moved to Orlando Florida, I found out our neighborhood had a park. I wanted to go all day but I had to help the family move furniture in the house until it was finally dark. I think it was 9pm when my friends and I finished. We decided to go to the park anyway. Little did we know, this neighborhood was huge and the park was about a mile away.  We were just little kids but we walked anyway. Once we got there, we jumped around, played and got tired. My friend had the bright idea of taking a nap at the park and we all said, "YEAH LETS DO IT!!!!" I'm sure it was about midnight when we woke up to the neighborhood security with his flashlight in our faces. He yelled at us and took us home. Boy oh boy did I make a mistake. When the security guy dropped us off, the lights in my house were still on and the front door was open. I walked inside and found my family still moving stuff around the house and they didn't even know I was gone. Phew, I escaped a slapping right there. Unfortunately, when I walked inside, I knocked over my moms favorite lamp. She even put cones around it. This woman slapped me so hard, I landed back at the park and slept there for the night. I cried. The broken lamp cried with me. I make sure I walk around cones from now on.

When I was little, my brother and I used to fish together all the time. We were too poor to own fishing rods so instead, we'd go to the dock and hope to find fishing string with hook on it. Usually we'd find them if we searched hard enough but this one time we found only a hook and no string attached. We wanted to fish so bad so we went back home to see if we could find anything there. After searching the garage and finding nothing again, my brother had an idea. He took the shoe laces off my dads tennis shoes and somehow tied the hook onto the lace. It was a pretty dumb idea but we went back to the dock with a piece of bread. We put it on the hook and tested our luck again. I for sure thought we weren't going to catch anything but within 10 seconds, a huge bass came by and took our whole rig. The shoe laces, hook and bread were gone. My brother and I jumped for joy because we saw a fish so big and that made it all worth it. We walked back home and found my dad and my uncle in the garage looking like they were about to go play tennis. My dad stood there with one shoe on and his other shoe in his hand. "Where is my shoe lace?" he asked. Before I could answer, my brother pointed at me and said, "Khoa threw it in the lake." Without further adieu, my dad slapped me so hard, the bass grew legs, walked to my house and delivered the shoe lace back. My dad laced his shoe and went on to play tennis. I cried. The bass cried with me. My bro laughed. I didn't trust him anymore after that one.

I remember a long time ago when I was a little boy, my mom was heading off to work and she told me to take the chicken out of the freezer so she could cook it when she got home. I told her yeah yeah okay got it and she left. I should've went straight to the freezer to take the chicken out but instead I sat down in front of the TV where my brother was playing on our brand new Super Nintendo. It was the most amazing thing I've ever seen. We switched off playing Super Mario and before I knew it, it was dark outside. I jumped up and told myself there was something I was supposed to do. After 2 seconds, I gave up trying to remember and went back to playing Super Mario. I got to a boss level where we had to fight a big chicken looking character. At that moment, I knew I messed up. I ran to the freezer and as I opened the freezer door, the garage door was opening. It was my mom. I threw the chicken in the microwave and hit 99:99 minutes praying for a miracle. My mom walked into the kitchen and knew what I was trying to do. I had never seen this woman so mad in my 7 years of existence. Her face turned red and her hands got bigger. She smacked me so hard, the chicken jumped out of the microwave and ran away. I was smacked so hard, the Super Nintendo reset with no game data saved. My brother was pissed. I cried. My bro cried. The chicken somewhere in the world cried with me as well. I always remember to take the chicken out of the freezer now.

Sometimes after the gym, I go to my moms house to eat because my sister stays up late and is always down to cook. Well the other night while I was eating steak, I was sitting at the table and Picasso the puppy was sitting right next to me on the ground. He stared at me while I ate. I am a huge sucker for dogs so I usually give them what they want. Little did I know, my sister was training him not to beg for food. I slipped him a piece of my steak and unfortunately my sister saw. She got angry. So angry she transformed and turned into my mom. If you have read some of these stories then you know my mom turns into a slapping beast when she's angry. So I said out loud, "Sorry mom I didn't mean to." which made my sister even more angry. This girl slapped me so hard, Picasso spit the piece of steak out because he felt bad for me. I was slapped so hard my head hit the table and bounced back up. When I opened my eyes I was sitting at my own dinner table with no steak in front of me. I got a text from my sister saying "you done messed up boy". I cried. I facetimed Picasso and he was crying too. I can't ever give that puppy a piece of my steak again.

When I was 16 years old, I remember sneaking my friends inside my room to play xbox all the time. I had a door that led to the backyard and that's where they would come in. The only problem was my mom planted a garden directly outside the door. I'm not sure why but that's what she did. Well all my friends knew to jump over the garden or tip toe around it to not break the plants except for my friend Ian. He was a little on the heavy side so all of us would hold his hands and swing him across. It worked every time and my moms garden was never damaged that way. Well one time, all my friends had already come over and we were in an intense game but Ian had to come late because he had to eat dinner with his family. I heard him outside the door but couldn't pause the game because we were playing online and the internet waits for nobody. My friends and I yelled out to him to just jump and he could do it when I knew dang well he could not do it. Well he jumped as high and as far as he could go but landed directly on my mom's mint leaves but didn't tell me. He walked in my room and joined the game and all was well. The next morning I woke up and went to school and when I came back home I found my mom in my room. She looked furious. In her hands she was holding her dead plants. This woman slapped me so hard, I did a double backflip and landed it 10/10!!!! I cried. My xbox cried. I told my friends what happened and they cried with me. My mom was mad but then she just made me and my friends dig up and move the garden to another place in the backyard. Everything is Gucci now. I want to start a gaming channel.

If you read the description at the top of this box, I talk about hope. Let me tell you about one time I hoped I would pass this chemistry exam after staying up all night playing video games. It was in the 10th grade on a Sunday night. I had just gotten Xbox 360 and all my friends were online. I knew I shouldn't have logged on but it was literally all my friends and I had to play at least play one game. Well before I knew it, it was 4 AM and we were still playing. I thought to myself, just finish this and I'll pull an all nighter studying. Thats when I heard the stomping and rumbling which I thought was from the game but it was outside my bedroom door. I was hoping it wasn't my mom. It was my mom. She came busting through the door and was not happy with what she was seeing. She slapped me so hard, my face landed on my chemistry book and my Xbox reset itself, no game data saved. I spent the rest of the night studying and hoping I would pass this test. Well the next morning I took the test. With belief, hope and what I remembered from class, I passed with a B minus. Luck was on my side. When I brought the test home for my mom to see she smacked me again. I could've gotten an A if I didn't play video games all night. I cried. My test cried. My Xbox cried with me as well. Apparently when my Xbox shut off, it kicked all my friends out of the game which erased all the progress we made in our game. I don't have friends anymore but I did earn better grades from that night on.

A longtime ago, I used to work two jobs so I was extremely tired when I got home. I usually got home very late as well, sometimes midnight or 1 in the morning. I also smelled like food because I worked at the restaurant. Well, I was pulling into my apartment complex when I saw a horse just walking along the sidewalk. I was so confused I stopped the car and rolled down my window. It was getting closer and closer to me. I had to be seeing things but I had to make sure  so I got out of my car to see better.  It wasn't a horse, it was a Great Dane and this Great Dane must've smelled the food on me. It was full on sprinting towards me so I ran. I ran so far away. Eventually I got to my apartment where Keren was fast asleep. I opened the door and slammed it. Unfortunately Keren woke up and while I was panicking, she rubbed her hands together. I remember my first day at school. I'm not sure if I told this story before and if I have I'm sorry. I was about 5 years old and I woke up in my bed one morning after falling asleep on the couch the night before. Very bizarre I know. But that's not the point. I woke up to the sound of my bedroom door opening and seeing my dad come in. I was so confused because the sun wasn't even up. He puts me in blue jeans and a colorful long sleeve shirt and carries me to the car. It was a foggy morning and the birds hadn't started chirping yet. My dad straps me in and we're off. We leave our neighborhood and shortly after, we arrive at an ominous brick building where I see other little kids hopping out of their cars and waving goodbye to their parents. My dad parks the car and walks around to get me out. He picks me up with one arm and clutched a backpack in the other. We walk towards the hallways and eventually arrive in front of a blue door. As my dad opens the door, I hear a roar of children on the other side. He sets me down on my feet and puts my arms through the straps of the backpack. As he scoots me into the classroom, he bends down and says, "Khoa, your name is Curtis and this is school. Find out what bus takes you home and I'll see you later. Behave." and just like that he gets up and walks out the door. The teacher walks over and asks me what my name was but I didn't understand her because I didn't even  speak English yet. I didn't even know what my dad said to me to be honest. That was the first time he had ever spoken that language to me. Eventually she figured out my American name was Curtis and she tried telling me to write Curtis on my paper but I refused because I thought my name was Khoa. I was so confused I cried. The teacher was frustrated so she cried too. Actually all the kids in class cried. What a great first day.

I remember when I first started crawling. I was about 8 months old and just beginning. Yes I was late because I was born 2 months premature. Well I was crawling on the floor when I passed my moms closet and saw a baby staring at me across the room. I looked away and looked back again. He was still staring at me. This kid would not lose eye contact as if I had just disrespected his mother or something. My 8 month old self was not having any of it today. I ate breakfast and had my bottle, I was pumped. So I crawled towards this little boy. He crawled towards me. I got a little intimidated so I stopped and looked away. I looked back and he had the audacity to keep staring at me. This was it! I crawled towards him and came face to face. I stuck my tongue out and so did he. I got so mad I raised my left hand and tried to smack him. Instead I smacked the mirror and it tipped over and broke on me. So if you look at the top of my left eye, you'll see a scar that's been there since then. Yes I cried. My reflection cried with me.

As many of you know by the title we got scammed so bad. It reminds me of another time I got scammed in high school. The brand new iPhone 3G had just come out and all my friends had one. I saw how it was touch screen and even had YouTube already installed. This blew my mind and I really wanted one. Unfortunately I couldn't afford a brand new phone so I looked up the prices of used phones. I saw that they were about $300 which was still expensive but I saw the value and wanted one so bad. I worked my butt off every single day and back then I only made $10 a day because my family was struggling at the time. I finally saved up $300 and contacted someone selling a white iPhone 3G. We met at a book store which was a public place and he was very fast when talking to me. I was so young and dumb I just handed him the money without inspecting the phone and he got in his car and drove away as fast as possible. I got back home and opened the box. The phone was completely broken. I tried calling the guy back but he used a temporary phone and cut it off. I was so sad. I didn't cry because my friends were there but inside I cried a lot. My new broken iPhone cried with me. I don't use craigslist anymore.

7qSK58t1110.description:
I remember the first time I ever brought food home for Keren. She wanted snow crab but I got myself pho. I was eating my soup when Keren asked for a bite. If you know me, you know I love my pho. So instead of saying no I added so much Sriracha hot sauce, she surely would not be able to handle it. Once I stirred it up, the soup was as red as Rudolph the red Reindeers nose. I showed Keren the bowl and asked if she'd still like to try it. Being brave, she dipped her spoon in and took a sip. Her face instantly started sweating. She opened her mouth and fire came out. SPICY! She yelled as I ran into my kitchen, opened the fridge and grabbed a can of soda. As soon as I gave it to her, she opened it and started chugging as fast as he could. After a couple gulps she spit it out all over my face. I looked at the can and it was actually beer. I ran back in the kitchen and got her a cup of water. Once her mouth wasn't enflamed with spice anymore she gave me the look. She picked up her snow crab leg and smacked me so hard I didn't wake up till the next morning and my pho was cold. I cried. My pho cried with me.

mlocZXF0LAo.description:
When I was younger, I always took 30 second showers because I was scared of the boogeyman or a ghost coming to get my while I had my eyes closed. Maybe I watched too many scary movies as a kid but one time while I was showering my brother snuck in to scare me. This was when I was the biggest scaredy cat in the world. I had just put shampoo in my hair and was washing it out as quick as I could when my brother smacked the shower curtain pretending he was a monster. I screamed and fell out of the shower grabbing onto the curtain. I tried opening my eyes but the soap dripped down and it burned so bad I had to close them again. I ran out the bathroom buck naked with the shower curtain wrapped around me. I rubbed the soap off my face and opened my eyes. Unfortunately I was standing in the middle of the living room where my mom had guests over for dinner. It was going to be an awkward dinner. I cried. The shower curtain cried. My dinner cried too. I stopped showering after that so if we ever meet and I'm stink you'll know why.

cWovf1HsCio.description:
I remember my first bad haircut. During the Summer, I shaved my head because it was so hot in Florida and I didn't care about how I looked. Well when school started, my hair had grown pretty long and I was going to shave it again eventually until my friend had the bright idea to cut my hair. She wanted to be a hair designer when she got older so it would be good practice for her. I told her to go ahead. I thought to myself, what's the worst that could happen? She completely butchered my hair. It was jacked up beyond repair. It looked like my hair got sucked into a vacuum cleaner and someone had to cut sections of it to get my head unstuck. Looked like a herd of mini sheep ran free on my head and ate patches of my hair which explained the random bald spots. I took one look in the mirror and it cracked. Gave me 7 years of bad luck. My reflection reached out and slapped me for letting this happen. She asked me to keep my hair like this because she was so proud of it. I didn't have the heart to tell her how bad it looked so instead I cried and nodded yes. She was so happy, she cried. I went home and my brother cried. He couldn't stop laughing. After that I never cut my hair again until I met Keren which explains my long hair in high school.

0dqVnCBBQOg.description:
When I was in the 5th grade I was always at my friends house after school. One day he asked me if I knew what prank phone calls were. I told him I had no idea so he told me it's when you call a number and you pretend to be someone else and make funny jokes. Back then there was no caller ID so you can't see the number of who was calling and he got away with pranking all the time. I thought that was funny so I asked him to do one for me so I could listen. He picked up the phone and started dialing. Ring Ring... "HELLO?!?!" I heard an angry asian lady on the other line and instantly knew who it was. My heart dropped because it was my mother. My friend replied, "Hello this is Khoa's teacher and I just wanted to let you know he has been a bad student and not turning in his homework." Then he hung up the phone and rolled on the floor laughing. I cried. My homework cried. My backpack cried. I cried all the way home until I walked through the door and my mom told me she bought a phone with caller ID and knew it was my friend. She called his mom and told her what he did. He got spanked that night. He cried. We still prank call each other to this day.

HMUZz7xhapc.description:
I remember when I was around 10 or 11 years old and my parents bought a lawn mower. It was one of the hottest days of the summer and my new chore was to mow the lawn. After an hour I was pretty exhausted so I sat down in the shade underneath a tree to rest a little. My neighbor came out and told me he would pay me if I mowed his lawn as well. I was already hot, tired and dirty so might as well do it! This would be the first time I would have my own money that I earned. I thought of everything I could buy. I was excited so I finished mowing my lawn and then mowed my neighbors right after. After I put the lawn mower away I sat on the edge of my driveway and my neighbor came over and told me I did a great job. He handed me a whole $20 bill. I sat in the garage admiring the money. A few moments later my mom came out and asked where I got that. I told her I earned it mowing our neighbors lawn. She said good and she took it from me. "This will help pay for the lawn mower." she said as she laughed. I cried. The lawn mower cried with me.

2YPQrG1lsJw.description:
When I was really young I remember going on a road trip with my family to Key West which is about 5 hours away from where I live. Our car didn't have any A/C so it was so hot during the drive. My parents packed a lot of gatorade and I remember chugging about 5 bottles  in the first hour. After doing so, I had to go to the bathroom really bad. I kept asking my parents to stop so I could go but they refused and said we were almost there. I couldn't hold it in so I took one of the empty gatorade bottles and went in there. I put the cap back on and that was that. I was relieved and ready to sleep the rest of the way. My brother woke up from his nap drenched in sweat. He was extremely thirsty so he reached out for the nearest drink. He grabbed a yellow gatorade that was on the seat. He opened it. He took a sip. It wasn't my pee if that's what you were thinking. ahhhhh gooootcha!!!! No but seriously, the real story is he drank my pee. I felt really bad. He spit it out on my face. I cried. He cried. My dad pulled over because we were crying and spanked us. We cried some more.

hG4ihSl90zY.description:
When I was in middle school I only had 1 friend. We were the quiet kids in school who spent our free time either doing homework or reading books together. One day during class, we noticed students passing notes to each other but we weren't getting any of them. Feeling left out, I wrote a note to pass to my friend. I wrote Hello! He sat right next to me so I just handed it to him. When he opened it, he laughed a little and wrote something right underneath my Hello! Once he was done, he folded it up and I stuck my hand out to get the note back but he passed it to the girl next to him. Confused, I tapped him on the shoulder and asked why he gave it to her. Then it happened. Our teacher walked by the girl and grabbed the note. My friend looked at me with his eyes wide opened and mouthed the words, I'm Sorry! The teacher read the note out loud to the class. "Hello! I have the biggest crush on you. Will you walk with me to my next class and hold my hand? -KHOA" The whole class laughed. I cried. My friend cried. The girl looked at me and shook her head no. I dropped out of school the next day. I'm just kidding but it was funny and embarrassing and I actually made some new friends after that.

When she was out of sight I crawled out the back door. I ran. I ran so far away. And I ran. I ran all night and day. It was nice knowing ya mom but I'm not ready to die just yet. I rode the rest of the way down laughing hard as I can until I got to the very bottom of the slope. Moolan was standing there and right next to her, Sydney in her purple sweater. I was confused. I looked at Sydney then up at the slope. The other girl in the purple sweater was not Sydney. She got up and rode down to the bottom of the slope. I cried. It was Keren. She was wearing a purple sweater that day as well. She smacked me so hard, I flew back up to the top of the slope. At least I didn't have to wait in line for the ski lift again.

My teacher told me to get off the floor. I cried. Why is my name Curtis? What am I doing here? Can I have the Wifi password? What is the meaning of life?

kGW9sSMDXKs.description:
When Keren was pregnant with Landon, she always craved pickles. At home she always had a jar of pickles in the fridge ready to satisfy her craving. I was not allowed to touch them. One night, a few friends of mine came over to meet at my house so we could take one car and go get drinks. They were hungry so I told them to eat anything out of my fridge except for the pickles. I waited outside for the Uber to arrive. Once it came, my friends walked outside and we all got in the car. I sat in the front seat. I smelled something weird. It was the smell of pickles. I turned around and saw all of my friends with pickles on their napkins. I asked them why the heck are they eating those! They said that I told them not to eat anything in the fridge except the pickles. I was horrified. I turned to look at the house but 7 month pregnant messy hair bun Keren was already out the front door walking towards us. I got out of the car to explain but she smacked me so hard, I flew to our final destination at the bar. A few moments later my friends landed right next to me. I cried. My friends were crying. At least we didn't have to pay the Uber.

AT6DchT-YQI.description:
In Florida we have a lot of bugs. Every now and then, you'll see an occasional cockroach that sneaks inside your home seeking shelter from the cold weather. Well the other night when I was up editing the vlog at around 2 AM, I went into the kitchen to grab a snack. I open the fridge and the bright light reveals a big cockroach right next to my foot. I could have jumped and screamed but my mind has been trained to not make a sound after 8:30 PM because that's when Jackson is put to bed and if I wake him up, Keren would give me a whoopin' of a life time. So I froze not making a single noise. Then, I  calmly backed away. I got a napkin and planned out my attack. I would jump from behind and capture him then flush him down the toilet. I crouched down so he couldn't see me coming. I inched towards him. I held the napkin up and all of a sudden the cockroach jumped up and started flying. "AAAAHHHHHH!!!!!", I yelled as I jumped on top of the counter knocking over some pots and pans.  "AAHHHHH!!!" I yelled again because I heard my bedroom door open. I knew it. My fate has been decided. "AAAAHHHHH!!!!" I yelled as Keren came stomping around the corner, her hand held high about to smack the life out of me. "AAAAHHHHH!!!!" I yelled as the cockroach landed on my face. In that instant, the cockroach and I both knew we messed up and our life flashed before our eyes. Keren smacked us so hard we laid on the kitchen floor for 3 days straight. Just crying every single day and night. Me and the cockroach cool now. We eat midnight-dinner together every Wednesday.

I kept asking Keren what should the title of the vlog be. She wouldn't answer me so I made it this... Please leave a comment below of what we should rename this vlog!! The one with the most likes is what we will rename the vlog to! Thank you!

The other day I was kicking Jackson's green ball around while cleaning out the garage. I knew I shouldn't have gotten side tracked because Keren had been nagging on me to clean it out for weeks but this ball was too much fun. I stood in the driveway and kicked the ball into the garage pretending it was a goal. I was good. I was reallllly good. I kept stepping back further and further but made it in every time. I got a little too confident so I decided to stand to the side of the garage and curve the ball in. I went back and kicked it as hard as I could and as soon as it went into the darkness of the garage, it made a smacking noise and came right back out. I stood there confused until I saw what came from the dark. It was Keren. She had just woken up from a nap like a dragon awakening from a century long slumber, well that's what I thought from the look of her droopy face. Maybe it was from the ball smacking her so hard but I fell to my knees and begged. I said, "Master please forgive me for I am a fool! I will clean the garage and massage yo..." and before I could finish my sentence, her hand like the paws of a grizzly bear smacked me so hard, I saw the light. I almost died but Keren woke me back up and told me to finish cleaning the garage. It's spotless now.

Yesterday was a rough day for me because Jackson was not feeling well and I was taking care of him without Keren which I'm not used to. He pulled his hand back and slapped me into the year 2020 where I saw future Jackson as a 5 year old speaking complete sentences. Future Jackson said to me, "Boy if you ever try to put me down without feeding me again I'll poop on your red shoes." Once I came back to the present, I fed Jackson chicken noodle soup and a side of grapes and mangos. He was happy again and fell right asleep.

A few years ago, I had an iPhone 5 with a waterproof case. I brought it in the shower with me all the time to play music. One time while showering, I started to get a FaceTime call from Keren. Of course I answered, we had been dating for over 5 years. I answered the FaceTime and it wasn't Keren. It was Kevin, a new friend I met at the gym a couple days before. My phone screen was foggy from the steam and covered the ending of the name. When I saw it was him, I screamed, he screamed. Keren ran into the bathroom, she screamed. Kevin hung up and never facetimed me again. We stick to texting now.

I'd like to personally say thank you as you are reading this right now. Yes you, reading this right now. Our house is filled with people and laughter and love. We are very lucky for that and we know it. But to have a family on YouTube is far beyond anything we could ever ask for. I feel so special to be able to interact, read comments, comment back, joke around, make meme's and just "hang out" with every subscriber. I can't even imagine what our life would be like without our YouTube family anymore! We love you!!!

Thank you so much to everyone that was able to come out and celebrate with Keren and I. The Gender Reveal Party was a complete success and I had such a great time. I'm so happy that I was able to share such a special moment in my life with some of my close friends and family. I can't wait to welcome my first baby to the world knowing I have all of you standing beside us.
Here is a little video Khoa put together of the party! If anyone would like to me to send a picture from the video just let me know! Thank you again and enjoy!!!
For those who don't know what's going on:
Khoa and I went to the ultrasound and asked the technician not to tell us the results of the gender but to seal the results in an envelope. We gave the unopened envelope to Taylor. She was the only one that knew the gender so she got a huge black balloon to fill with colored confetti. If it was a boy, she filled it with blue. If it was a girl, she filled it with pink. At the party, Khoa and I and everyone else still have no idea what our first child will be until we pop the balloon.
